2610.02504.title: HXAI: Hierarchical Privacy-Preserving Explainable AI in Distributed Energy Systems
2610.02504.paper_summary: Balancing electricity demand and supply is increasingly difficult due to the inherent intermittency of renewable power generation and the stochastic power consumption. Grid operators require fine-grained, decision-relevant insights into household energy consumption to manage peak loads and design responsive tariffs, but increased transparency at this level raises significant privacy concerns. Traditional methods for explainable AI (XAI) can reveal sensitive information, while standard privacy techniques often reduce the usefulness of explanations. To address this issue, we introduce HXAI, a hierarchical framework that preserves privacy while enabling reasonable explainable analysis for grid-level demand management. HXAI consists of two main components: (1) a local model that generates fine-grained explanations within a secure, private environment, and (2) a zonal model that aggregates these explanations to support grid-level analysis while enforcing privacy through flexible privacy-budget management. We explicitly limit cumulative privacy exposure under repeated operator queries and show that the proposed framework preserves decision-relevant information without compromising household privacy. Experiments on both simulated and real-world energy datasets demonstrate that HXAI provides useful insights for zonal load management while ensuring that appliance-level consumption remains local and is never transmitted to grid operators. Our results show that preserving the semantic structure of explanations, rather than minimizing numerical error, is the key to XAI under differential privacy. This framework provides a way to achieve both privacy and explainability in energy management.
2610.02504.paper_summary_zh: 平衡電力需求與供應變得越來越困難，這是由於可再生能源發電的固有間歇性和隨機的電力消耗所致。<lb/>電網運營商需要對家庭能源消耗進行細緻的、與決策相關的洞察，以管理高峰負荷並設計響應性收費，但在這一層面的透明度提高引發了重大隱私問題。<lb/>傳統的可解釋人工智慧（XAI）方法可能會揭示敏感信息，而標準的隱私技術往往會降低解釋的實用性。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了HXAI，一個在保護隱私的同時，能夠實現合理可解釋分析的分層框架，以便進行電網級需求管理。<lb/>HXAI由兩個主要組件組成：（1）一個在安全、私密環境中生成細緻解釋的本地模型，以及（2）一個聚合這些解釋以支持電網級分析的區域模型，同時通過靈活的隱私預算管理來強化隱私。<lb/>我們明確限制在重複運營商查詢下的累積隱私暴露，並展示所提出的框架在不妨礙家庭隱私的情況下保持與決策相關的信息。<lb/>在模擬和現實世界能源數據集上的實驗表明，HXAI為區域負荷管理提供了有用的洞察，同時確保設備級消耗保持本地化，並且從不傳輸給電網運營商。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，保持解釋的語義結構，而不是最小化數值誤差，是在差異隱私下實現XAI的關鍵。<lb/>這個框架提供了一種在能源管理中實現隱私和可解釋性的方法。
